description: Declare a Snowflake table as an observable external asset.

create_observation_sensor.label: Create Observation Sensor
create_observation_sensor.description: Also create the polling sensor that keeps this external asset's health/data-version current (same logic as the standalone snowflake_table_observation_sensor component). When False (default), this component only declares the AssetSpec.

sensor_name.label: Sensor Name
sensor_name.description: Unique sensor name. Defaults to '{asset_key}__observation_sensor'. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

username_env_var.label: Username Env Var
username_env_var.description: Env var with Snowflake username. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

password_env_var.label: Password Env Var
password_env_var.description: Env var with password. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

authenticator.label: Authenticator
authenticator.description: Snowflake authenticator: 'SNOWFLAKE_JWT' (keypair), 'externalbrowser' (SSO), 'oauth', etc. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

private_key_file_env_var.label: Private Key File Env Var
private_key_file_env_var.description: Env var holding the path to a PEM RSA private key file (for authenticator='SNOWFLAKE_JWT'). Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

private_key_file_pwd_env_var.label: Private Key File Pwd Env Var
private_key_file_pwd_env_var.description: Env var holding the passphrase for an encrypted private key file (optional). Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

token_env_var.label: Token Env Var
token_env_var.description: Env var holding an OAuth / PAT token (with authenticator='oauth' or PAT). Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

warehouse.label: Warehouse
warehouse.description: Snowflake warehouse to use. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

check_interval_seconds.label: Check Interval Seconds
check_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between health checks. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Optional Dagster resource key. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Run an extra `SELECT * LIMIT preview_rows` against the table and include the result as a markdown preview on the AssetObservation. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows in the preview SELECT when include_preview_metadata=True.

emit_materialization.label: Emit Materialization
emit_materialization.description: When True (default), the sensor emits AssetMaterialization. When False, emits AssetObservation instead. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: ISO start date for time-based partition types (e.g. '2024-01-01').

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static / multi partition types.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

name: External Snowflake Table
